يستحرمون (form X)
# يَسْتَحْرِمُونَ (yastaḥrimūna) /jas.taħ.ri.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# يُسْتَحْرَمُونَ (yustaḥramūna) /jus.taħ.ra.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
